description: Client roles of the baobab-cp workforce client. They are fine-grained Control Plane responsibilities, kept out of the deliberately small realm-role namespace (ADR-0009 §102-104). Each is the transitional IAM enforcement of a responsibility that ADR-BCP-020 AdministrativeGrants will take over; baobab-cp honours the matching scope only when the token also carries the role. Every role composites iam:mfa-required. None is a default role, and none grants cp:platform-admin, which baobab-cp requires separately.

roles.name: onboarding-requester
roles.description: Platform Onboarding Operator (ADR-BCP-017 §§22, 39): may create, fulfil and cancel TenantOnboardingRequests with onboarding:request. Never together with onboarding-authoriser (config/governance/role-policy.json).

roles.name: onboarding-authoriser
roles.description: Platform Onboarding Approver (ADR-BCP-017 §§22, 39): may authorise a REQUESTED TenantOnboardingRequest with onboarding:authorise. Never together with onboarding-requester (config/governance/role-policy.json).
